data.name: GroupedChartDescription
data.value: Displays dataset records as a grouped chart using sum or average aggregation.

data.name: Description_SelectTheTableAndViewToVisualize
data.value: Select the table and view whose records should be visualized in the chart.

data.name: Description_SelectWhichChartTypeShouldBeRendered
data.value: Select whether the chart should be rendered as a doughnut chart, a half doughnut chart, a pie chart, a vertical funnel chart, or a horizontal funnel chart.

data.name: Description_EnterTheLogicalNameOfTheFieldUsedForGrouping
data.value: Enter the logical name of the field whose values should define the chart segments.

data.name: Description_SelectWhetherTheChartUsesSumOrAverage
data.value: Select whether the numeric field should be aggregated as a sum or as an average for each group.

data.name: Description_EnterTheLogicalNameOfTheNumericFieldToAggregate
data.value: Enter the logical name of the numeric field that should be summed or averaged.

data.name: Description_ShowDataNextToChart
data.value: Show a small data grid to the right of the chart with the grouped values.

data.name: Validation_DatasetRequired
data.value: Select a dataset before the chart can be rendered.

data.name: Validation_GroupByFieldRequired
data.value: Enter a logical field name in Group by field.

data.name: Validation_ValueFieldRequired
data.value: Enter a logical field name in Value field.

data.name: Validation_NoChartDataMessage
data.value: No chart data is available for the current dataset and configuration.

data.name: Validation_GenericConfigurationMessage
data.value: Check the chart configuration. One or more settings could not be read, so the chart could not be rendered.
